description: Consolidated operator decision ledger — carries forward Phase 14.5 decisions with status tracking, adds new decisions from 13-layer design pass
note: System recommendations are NOT operator decisions. If the operator has not explicitly selected an option, status remains 'pending'.

options: A: Promote Beast feature/company-system to main
B: Selectively merge Beast features to GitHub main
C: Keep GitHub main, discard Beast
decisions.rationale: Beast is 3x larger, has Clerk, has company system. GitHub main is stale Replit code.
Smallest coherent product. Fix auth first, then build minimum useful.

options: B: PRD v1 + selective v2 features
decisions.rationale: v2 likely reflects current deployed state. MVP already works.

options: A: CreatorOS first (fix bypass, then Clerk)
B: EOS first (Beast already has Clerk)
D: CreatorOS bypass fix first, then EOS, then LyfeOS
decisions.system_recommendation: D: CreatorOS bypass fix → EOS validation → LyfeOS standardization
blocked_actions: Auth migration execution for any app
decisions.rationale: CreatorOS auth bypass is P0 security. EOS Clerk needs validation. LyfeOS auth works and can wait.

options: C: Full standard with enforced CI gates
decisions.rationale: 13-layer defaults are now defined. Enforcement requires CI which doesn't exist yet.

options: A: Minimal — governance and source truth only
C: Full — governance + orchestration + intelligence + agents
decisions.system_recommendation: B: Governance + deployment orchestration (near term), C (long term)
decisions.rationale: Start with governance, expand to orchestration. Full integration requires APIs that don't exist yet.

options: B: After source convergence and auth decisions
C: After first app is deployment-ready
decisions.system_recommendation: B: After source convergence and auth decisions
decisions.rationale: Provisioning before decisions wastes resources on potentially wrong configuration.

options: C: After all decisions ratified + 13-layer design complete
decisions.system_recommendation: C: After all decisions ratified + 13-layer design complete
decisions.rationale: Building before decisions are ratified risks building the wrong thing.

options: A: Define per-app MVP production criteria
B: All 13 layers must be implemented
C: Minimum 8 critical layers (auth, DB, deploy, security, errors, recovery, CI/CD, frontend)
blocked_actions: Readiness gate evaluation has no concrete threshold
decisions.rationale: Each app has different risk profiles and maturity. LyfeOS may need hardening, not 13-layer completion.

options: B: Add to hardening work packet
decisions.rationale: Data loss is irreversible. Verification takes minutes.

decisions.system_recommendation: D: Defer until closer to deployment
decisions.rationale: No app is close to deployment. Decision can wait.

options: A: Passive — governance and source truth only
B: Active governance — deployment gates, security gates
C: Active orchestration — agents, AI, intelligence
decisions.rationale: Governance is achievable now. Full orchestration requires APIs that don't exist.

summary.doctrine: System recommendations are informational. They are NOT operator decisions. Status remains 'pending' until the operator explicitly selects an option.
